property_summary: For any callee address, C.forward(...) returns (i.e. does not revert) exactly when the low-level call to callee succeeds; the mutant inverts the call result so it will revert precisely when the callee call succeeds (and succeed when it reverts), violating this rule for callees that revert.
change_summary: Negate the call result by inverting the boolean assignment so _s receives !result, causing revert behavior to flip.
